Validator.default: Message filter used by raw handlers to decide which incoming WebSocket frames match. Validators can be combined with `all`, `any` and `ne`.

new.default: Creates a validator that matches every message.

regex.default: Creates a validator that matches messages against a regular expression.

contains.default: Creates a validator that matches messages containing the given substring.

starts_with.default: Creates a validator that matches messages starting with the given prefix.

ends_with.default: Creates a validator that matches messages ending with the given suffix.

ne.default: Creates a validator that matches messages the given validator does NOT match.

all.default: Creates a validator that matches only when every given validator matches.

any.default: Creates a validator that matches when at least one of the given validators matches.

check.default: Returns true if the given message matches this validator.
